XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sporadic drop in engine speed and engine fault warning light comes on
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | PEDAL | ACCELERATOR | P0220 | P1220 | ON | LIGHTS UP | YELLOW | YELLOW | MIL | MISSING | LOSING | IDLE | LOWER | LOW | DECREASE |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Fuel injection

  • Component: Accelerator pedal

  • Fault: Occasionally, the engine speed drops whilst idling and the engine fault light comes on

  • Errors detected by the on-board diagnostics:
    • P1220 (Accelerator pedal position sensor – Incorrect signal )
    • P0220 (Throttle position sensor, section 2 – open circuit)
  • Cause: Faulty accelerator pedal

• Action: Check that the accelerator pedal is working properly and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In the case in question, the "Reset adaptive parameters" adjustment was initially performed without resolving the anomaly. The definitive solution came with the replacement of the accelerator pedal alone
